name: Jirai Kei Nemu
summary: 陪伴工作与专注计时的像素桌面伙伴，包含喝茶、阅读与休息动作。 开发者披露角色像素精灵、图库插画及商店图像从 AI 辅助草稿开始，经人工修整；游玩时不生成 AI 内容。

aiAreaNotes.ingame: 开发者明确称游玩时不生成 AI 内容。
aiAreaNotes.art: 角色精灵以 AI 辅助草稿为起点，由团队逐像素修整。
aiAreaNotes.marketing: 商店图片与图库插画使用 AI 辅助草稿后人工修整。

steamReleaseDate: Coming soon（计划；核查时尚未发售）

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Every pixel-art character sprite in the game was retouched and finished pixel by pixel by our team, starting from AI-assisted drafts. Gallery illustrations and store images were also drafted with AI assistance and then retouched by hand. No AI-generated content is created during gameplay.
